item.title: Kane prematurely announced as Ballon d'Or winner - but he wasn't only one
item.description:
⚽ Harry Kane's dream of winning the Ballon d'Or came true on Monday, but a few hours earlier organisers prematurely released an article claiming he had clinched the award.

item.title: Kane ends England's 25-year Ballon d'Or wait - how he bucked the trend
item.description:
⚽ Harry Kane becomes the first English player to win the Ballon d'Or since Michael Owen in 2001 after being crowned the world's best player at a ceremony in London.
